answer: Make each agent identity earn standing through bonded, peer-verified work: a newcomer locks a small refundable deposit and completes attested tasks before its votes or trades count. A quill-signed record of every completed job builds a reputation trail no fresh fake can copy, while a marble-hard rule slashes the bond when audits link accounts to coordinated fraud. A violet flag marks accounts whose history is too thin to trust, so a sybil swarm pays real capital per identity and still starts at zero influence.
